subject: VaultBridge RFI: DPA annex, cross-border transfer evidence, key custody
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.t@vaultbridge.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: DPA annex, cross-border transfer evidence, key management

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this — VaultBridge is compiling a short evidence pack for our procurement/legal review and we have a focused list of items needed to complete our DPA annex and cross-border transfer assessment. Can you provide the following by EOD next Tue (2028-07-05)?

1) A draft DPA annex or template we can review (redlines expected).
2) SOC 2 summary and the date of the last audit; any carve-outs.
3) A mapping of cross-border transfers relevant to EU data subjects (which subprocessors, locations, lawful bases used).
4) Confirmation whether Redwood relies on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), DPF or other transfer mechanisms — and links to evidence.
5) KMS/key custody model: do you offer customer-managed keys (CMK) or BYOK? If CMK, where are keys hosted and who has administrative access?
6) Encryption at rest / in transit specifics (algorithms, TLS config, HSM usage).
7) Retention and deletion guarantees for customer data processed in inference workloads.
8) Any on-prem or VPC deployment options we could leverage for sensitive workloads.
9) List of subprocessors and a recent subprocessor change log.
10) Any relevant attestations or certifications for cross-border transfer compliance (DPF mappings, assessments).

We attached our RFI checklist to this message to keep answers aligned to our template. If anything requires legal review or a brief call, please tell us availability for a 30-minute slot.

Appreciate the help — we hope to close this quickly.

Best,
Amelia Torres
Head of Legal Ops, VaultBridge
[Attachment: vaultbridge-rfi-checklist.pdf]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.t@vaultbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: DPA annex, cross-border transfer evidence, key management

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear list. Quick reply below with high-level answers; Laura (cc) is our privacy counsel and will add formal points and the legal redline. We're happy to schedule a 30-minute call; I have availability Tue 07/05 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 07/06 14:00-16:00 PT.

Summary answers (high level):
1) DPA annex: attached is a draft DPA annex we use for enterprise customers (redwood-dpa-annex-draft-v1.pdf). It includes a cross-border section and standard processor obligations.
2) SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II; last audit period ended 2028-03. See attached summary (redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA.
3) Cross-border transfers: we maintain a transfer map for common SaaS flows; attached is an export of our DPF mapping for EU workloads (redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx). It lists primary subprocessors and geographic locations.
4) Transfer mechanisms: we use SCCs as the baseline for EU->US transfers and can supplement with DPF mappings where requested. We support controller-initiated SCCs and will include an SCC exhibit in the DPA annex if you prefer.
5) KMS/keys: Redwood offers both provider-managed KMS and a customer-managed key (CMK) option via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). BYOK is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers, keys can be customer-managed with HSM-backed KMS; administrative access is limited to designated customer admins and our key-escrow operations under strict controls.
6) Encryption: TLS 1.2+ (prefer 1.3) for in-transit; AES-256-GCM at rest. HSM-backed key storage for CMK flows; we can supply cipher suites and config on request.
7) Retention/deletion: data retention is configurable by route; default inference logs retained 30 days unless contractual changes. We support deletion requests and documented wipe processes for Private deployments.
8) Deployment options: Private (VPC/on-prem) available for regulated workloads; we can provide an on-prem deployment checklist.
9) Subprocessors: subprocessors list included in the DPF mapping XLSX; we keep a change log and provide 30-day notice for material changes.
10) Attestations: SOC 2 and our transfer mappings are primary; we can provide a DPF summary and prior assessment work on request.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-annex-draft-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf, redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx.

Next steps: Laura will add legal redlines to the DPA annex. Would you like us to prepare an SCC exhibit or a DocuSign-ready annex? Also please confirm the primary region for your EU workloads so we can mark the transfer map accordingly.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: redwood-dpa-annex-draft-v1.pdf] [Attachment: redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf] [Attachment: redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx]

Michael — thanks for the quick summary and the attachments. A few follow-ups before we loop in legal:

- Can you provide the specific SCC clause reference version you use (2010 vs 2021 SCCs)? We need confirmation of the template (and a sample signed SCC if possible).
- For CMK: what exact administrative roles can request key export or key destruction? Do you hold any escrowed copy of customer keys for hosted CMK, or are keys exclusively under customer control?
- For the DPF mapping: is there a machine-readable export (CSV/JSON) we can ingest into our compliance tool, or only XLSX?

Also, we may request a short call focused on key custody and transfer legalities only — would Laura be available to join if we schedule a legal-only slot? Our preferred times: Tue 07/05 16:00-17:00 CET or Wed 07/06 09:00-10:00 CET.

Best,
Amelia

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.t@vaultbridge.com>, michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: DPA annex, cross-border transfer evidence, key management

Hi Amelia — Laura here from Redwood Legal. Thanks for the follow-ups. Short answers and what we're attaching. Happy to join a legal-only call Tue 07/05 16:00 CET (I can make that).

SCCs: we use the EU Commission 2021 SCCs as our default. We can provide a sample signed SCC exhibit for inbound/outbound tests — typically provided in executed order forms for customers who require it.

CMK and key custody: for hosted CMK we integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) where the customer controls the key material. We do not retain exportable private key material when CMK is used; keys are HSM-protected and subject to MFA and restricted IAM roles. Our operations team does not have a plain-text copy of customer private keys. In scenarios where escrow is required (rare), we use an audited key-escrow provider and will document the escrow process in the DPA exhibit. Administrative roles that can request key rotation or destruction are restricted to named customer admins and a small set of audited ops identities — we'll enumerate in the annex.

DPF export: we can provide CSV/JSON exports of the DPF mapping — I've attached a machine-friendly CSV extract.

Attached: dpa-annex-redline.docx (legal redline with SCC exhibit option), redwood-dpf-mapping.csv (machine export), and a link to a sample executed SCC exhibit under NDA.

If you confirm Tue 07/05 16:00 CET, I'll join and we can walk through custody controls and the redlines.

Regards,
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
